title: Analytical Study of Minimizers of an N-Field System with Sphere-Valued Constraints
summary: This paper investigates a variational model that describes a system of N coupled sphere-valued fields through a penalization term imposing the constraint that their sum coincides with a prescribed sphere value map. We analyze the asymptotic behavior and regularity of minimizers as the penalization parameter tends to infinity. A fundamental dichotomy is established according to the number of interacting fields.
